ownership_reason: Only the per-segment comparison reads the coordinates of a segment; the facade, the winding-rule check, the lock-step walk and the two pass-throughs hold nothing but the two path iterators, so none of them can bring the coordinates of a quadratic segment into the verdict with a one-line change. The number of coordinates each segment type carries is fixed outside the gold: SerialUtilities.readShape rebuilds a SEG_QUADTO segment from four coordinates (quadTo(args[0], args[1], args[2], args[3])) beside move/line (two) and cubic (six), and writeShape writes every segment's coordinates; the sibling equal overloads compare every defining value of their shapes (both end points of a Line2D, frame, angles and type of an Arc2D, both coordinate arrays of a Polygon). The gold's javadoc promises that equal segments have the same coordinates, which two quadratic segments with different points violate.
